meta.name: tikhub
meta.description: Use TikHub APIs and helper scripts for Douyin, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, and related social-media data workflows.

copy.tagline: 通过API和脚本自动化社交媒体数据工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果频繁需要从多平台采集社交媒体数据进行分析
copy.tagline_en: Automate social media data workflows using APIs and scripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to collect social media data from multiple platforms for analysis

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会使用 TikHub API 和辅助脚本来处理抖音、TikTok、小红书等社交媒体的数据抓取、下载和元数据查询任务，并优先使用已有脚本，在运行前提示 API 成本与限制。
howto.when: 当用户要求抓取、下载或查询抖音、TikTok、小红书等平台的数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我下载那个抖音视频的元数据。
say.note: Claude 会调用 TikHub API 获取视频信息。

say.text: 查询小红书用户的最新10条笔记。
say.note: Claude 使用辅助脚本拉取数据并返回结果。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to use TikHub APIs and helper scripts for data fetching, downloading, and metadata lookup across platforms like Douyin, TikTok, and Xiaohongshu, prioritizing bundled scripts and surfacing API cost/limits before execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests data fetching, downloading, or metadata queries for platforms such as Douyin, TikTok, or Xiaohongshu.

say_en.text: Download the metadata of that Douyin video.
say_en.note: Claude calls TikHub API to get video info.

say_en.text: Get the latest 10 notes of a Xiaohongshu user.
say_en.note: Claude uses helper scripts to fetch and return results.
